),
plant_claim_counts AS (

WITH site_risk_profiles AS (

),
site_soiling_metrics AS (

    ec.env_snapshot->>'soiling_loss_index_percentage' AS soiling_loss_index_percentage
FROM plants p

)

WITH normalized_panels AS (
SELECT
    "modkey" AS panel_id,
    LOWER("pnlkind") AS technology_type_normalized,
    1.0 - ("effpct" / 100.0) AS degradation_factor
FROM "panel_models"
),
valid_panel_records AS (
SELECT
    p.sitelink AS panel_id,
    pm.pnlkind AS technology_type,
    ep.elec_perf_snapshot->>'initial_voltage' AS initial_voltage,
    ep.elec_perf_snapshot->>'current_voltage' AS current_voltage
FROM plant_panel_model p
JOIN panel_models pm ON p.modlink = pm.modkey
JOIN plant_record pr ON p.sitelink = pr.sitetie
JOIN electrical_performance ep ON pr.snapkey = ep.snaplink
WHERE ep.elec_perf_snapshot->>'initial_voltage' IS NOT NULL
  AND ep.elec_perf_snapshot->>'current_voltage' IS NOT NULL
  AND ep.elec_perf_snapshot->>'initial_voltage' != '0'
),
avg_degradation_per_tech AS (
SELECT
    pnlkind AS technology_type_normalized,
    AVG(degyrrate) AS average_degradation_factor
FROM "panel_models"
WHERE pnlkind IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY pnlkind
)
SELECT technology_type_normalized, average_degradation_factor
FROM avg_degradation_per_tech
